svg.title: Use the terminal for an agent or a saved command
svg.desc: Three states of the same terminal: the shell starts Claude Code; the researcher asks the agent to regenerate a figure and prepare a checked command, then exits; the shell runs the saved just figures command directly.
svg.text: One terminal, different programs receiving input
1. Start Claude Code from the shell
The shell starts the agent program
2. Give the agent a research task
Regenerate the figure from saved estimates.
Prepare and check just figures for next time.
3. Repeat a saved task from the shell
Saved code runs without an LLM call
